ana (docs): Quick note: i'm opening a small PR to tidy the function/tool calling docs so examples use the new invoke envelope consistently. link: https://github.com/redwood/inference/pull/4620. Need help updating snippets and a short migration blurb.
kai (sdk): I can update TS + PY snippets. plan: show a minimal v2 quickstart, plus a tiny fallback helper for older `function_call` shapes.
neel (runtime): runtime emits v2 by default on hosted. Dedicated clusters may still run compat-mode. docs should include the `redwoodctl` toggle command and a short note about header differences (kv cache hints are best-effort).
sophie (qa): i'll add three sample responses (compact v2, expanded schema, validation fail) and curl commands for the PR tests. will post artifacts here when ready.
kana (docs): thanks — please also add a tiny guardrail example: validate schema, reject with clear error, log `schema_failure`. keep snippets compact.
kai (sdk): draft TS snippet I'll push shortly; it uses `safeFirstOutput(resp)` helper instead of nested indexing. also adding `parseWithFallback(resp)` for permissive parsing.
neel (runtime): please avoid recommending direct access to `function_call.args` in prod without a compatibility check. show `if (client.config.compatibility)` guard.
sophie (qa): note: in compat-mode we sometimes see empty `outputs` while function_call exists; include troubleshooting bullet to check signed manifests and runtime logs.
kana (docs): good catch. i'll add troubleshooting + the on-prem KMS re-sign note with support link.
docbot: Preview for PR 4620 is up: https://docs.redwood.ai/pr-4620 (expires in 6 days).
kana (docs): target merge after QA artifacts and a quick crosslink sweep. timeline: EOD tomorrow. thanks everyone :thumbsup:
